import re


def compare_g3_highlight_speech_timing(slide_duration_ms, segments):
    if (
        type(slide_duration_ms) is not int
        or slide_duration_ms <= 0
        or type(segments) is not list
        or len(segments) == 0
    ):
        return {
            "technical_highlight_segment_timing_match": False,
            "mismatched_segments": [],
            "invalid_input": True,
            "independent_video_acceptance": False,
            "independent_acoustic_acceptance": False,
            "independent_scientific_acceptance": False,
            "student_publication_authorized": False,
        }

    expected_keys = {"element_id", "narration_id", "start_ms", "end_ms"}
    id_pattern = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?")
    seen_narration_ids = set()

    for segment in segments:
        if type(segment) is not dict or set(segment.keys()) != expected_keys:
            return {
                "technical_highlight_segment_timing_match": False,
                "mismatched_segments": [],
                "invalid_input": True,
                "independent_video_acceptance": False,
                "independent_acoustic_acceptance": False,
                "independent_scientific_acceptance": False,
                "student_publication_authorized": False,
            }

        element_id = segment["element_id"]
        narration_id = segment["narration_id"]
        start_ms = segment["start_ms"]
        end_ms = segment["end_ms"]

        if (
            type(element_id) is not str
            or type(narration_id) is not str
            or id_pattern.fullmatch(element_id) is None
            or id_pattern.fullmatch(narration_id) is None
            or narration_id in seen_narration_ids
            or type(start_ms) is not int
            or type(end_ms) is not int
            or start_ms < 0
            or end_ms <= start_ms
        ):
            return {
                "technical_highlight_segment_timing_match": False,
                "mismatched_segments": [],
                "invalid_input": True,
                "independent_video_acceptance": False,
                "independent_acoustic_acceptance": False,
                "independent_scientific_acceptance": False,
                "student_publication_authorized": False,
            }

        seen_narration_ids.add(narration_id)

    mismatched_segments = []
    prev_end_ms = None

    for index, segment in enumerate(segments, start=1):
        start_ms = segment["start_ms"]
        end_ms = segment["end_ms"]
        exceeds_duration = end_ms > slide_duration_ms
        overlaps_preceding = prev_end_ms is not None and start_ms < prev_end_ms
        if exceeds_duration or overlaps_preceding:
            mismatched_segments.append(index)
        prev_end_ms = end_ms

    return {
        "technical_highlight_segment_timing_match": len(mismatched_segments) == 0,
        "mismatched_segments": mismatched_segments,
        "invalid_input": False,
        "independent_video_acceptance": False,
        "independent_acoustic_acceptance": False,
        "independent_scientific_acceptance": False,
        "student_publication_authorized": False,
    }
